metadata.summary: Bounded Kanban documentary state and conservative lifecycle-event polling; no execution control.

semantics.description: See ../DESIGN.md. Sole backend authority, public board mapping and trusted exact caller enforcement. Documentary triage create/title-body edit/comments only. Last-writer-wins, best-effort requestKey not native idempotency. Unknown writes never retried automatically; broker timeout/cancel also UNKNOWN mutation outcome. Events always continuity UNKNOWN, bounded pull, replay duplicates expected. No dispatch/control/dependencies or production adoption.
